findings.summary: Changing the grading context updates the score-derived component values and point details visually, but the live status announces neither those values nor their details.
findings.fix: Include a concise summary of changed Exam/Quiz percentages in the existing polite status announcement when the grading context changes, coalescing it with the calculated-grade or missing-score message rather than adding another live region.
findings.evidence: detail.textContent and input.value are updated; the status announces the calculated grade or missing assessment types.
